summary.zh-CN: 会话记录无法保存时停止运行并报告原因，避免只在内存中继续回复。
summary.en-US: Stop affected runs and report the cause when conversation history cannot be saved.

body.zh-CN: 写入失败时停止受影响的运行并明确报错，清空未执行的排队输入。保留首次底层原因，避免相同故障反复刷屏；其它正常会话仍可使用。修正存储问题后重启并重新发送未完成请求。
body.en-US: A write failure stops the affected run, reports the error, and clears pending inputs. The first underlying cause is retained without repeated log flooding; healthy sessions remain usable. Fix storage access, restart, and resend unfinished requests.

body.zh-CN: 已有会话因权限或 I/O 问题无法读取时，不再将它误当成不存在。原始会话文件保留；从未成功写入的内容不能由本次修复找回。
body.en-US: Permission and I/O errors no longer cause an existing session to be treated as missing. Original session files are retained; content that was never successfully saved cannot be recovered by this fix.
